In detail

Sampierdarena, west of the port: dense, working, and a standing target of joint police operations. One reported in April 2026 put 138 officers into Sampierdarena, Cornigliano and Bolzaneto, identifying 920 people, with an arrest for drug trafficking and ten charges for illegal occupation and weapons. The Ministry of the Interior describes the operations here as aimed at drug dealing, street drinking and illegal occupation of buildings. There are cheap hotels in it and the daytime streets are ordinary; the rating is for after dark.
